pull.title: jobs: add category-aware nearby discovery
pull.body:
## Summary
- add optional `category` filtering to public `GET /jobs/nearby`
- support both exact leaf slugs and parent-category slugs across direct selectable children
- preserve the existing PostGIS nearby path when no category is supplied
- keep radius validation, distance ordering and public-only location data unchanged
- isolate geospatial discovery in a dedicated `NearbyJobDiscoveryService` instead of expanding lifecycle-oriented `JobService`
- add unit coverage plus a PostgreSQL/PostGIS runtime smoke that verifies leaf and parent filters and exact-address privacy
- document the shared paginated/nearby category contract

## Architecture / privacy
The category predicate is evaluated server-side against persisted `job_categories` relationships and combined with the existing `ST_DWithin` predicate. Exact coordinates and private location labels are never returned by public discovery. No Flyway migration is needed.

## Merge gate
Do not merge unless API verify, frontend audit/lint/build, full container/runtime smoke including the new nearby-category PostGIS test, and payments-ledger smoke are all green.

issue.title: jobs: add category-aware nearby discovery
issue.body:
## Summary
- add optional `category` slug filtering to public `GET /jobs/nearby`
- preserve the existing PostGIS nearby path when no category is supplied
- support exact leaf slugs and parent-category slugs across direct selectable children
- normalize category slugs consistently with paginated `GET /jobs`
- keep distance ordering, radius bounds and public-only location data unchanged
- add focused service tests for filtered and legacy nearby routing
- document the shared discovery/category contract

## Architecture / privacy
The category predicate is evaluated server-side against persisted `job_categories` relationships and combined with the existing PostGIS `ST_DWithin` predicate. Exact coordinates and private location labels are still not returned by public discovery. No Flyway migration is needed because the category FK/catalog and geospatial columns already exist.

## Verification
Do not merge unless GitHub CI and payments-ledger smoke are green. Existing runtime smoke remains responsible for PostGIS/Flyway/API behavior; focused unit tests cover category normalization and repository routing.
